name: Plaid
description: Connect banks from any device and query balances, transactions, recurring payments, investments, and loans with your own Plaid credentials.
installationSteps: Install this plugin, then ask a Bot to set up Plaid on your connected computer or its Linux computer.
The Bot asks for your Plaid client ID and environment's secret if missing. Production access is required for real banks.
Open the Bot's Hosted Link URL on your laptop or phone, complete bank login, then say done so it saves and verifies the connection.
Uninstalling the plugin removes its skills; the separately installed CLI, credentials, and bank connections require separate cleanup.

skills.name: plaid-setup
skills.description: Prepare the CLI and Python helpers, request missing Plaid keys, and configure the chosen computer and environment.

skills.name: plaid-connections
skills.description: Connect banks through Hosted Link from any device, resume sessions, list accounts, or remove a selected connection.

skills.name: plaid-financial-data
skills.description: Query balances, transactions, recurring payments, investments, or liabilities for connected accounts.

skills.name: plaid-troubleshooting
skills.description: Diagnose Plaid CLI setup, credential, product-access, or bank connection errors.
